title: KuCoin Earn

notes: First-party article stating Simple Earn Fixed became available to all eligible users from 30 May 2024 and describing fixed-term lending-order matching and interest accrual.

title: Crypto Simple Earn
notes: Current first-party product page confirming Simple Earn remains active with flexible and fixed offerings and describing lending-based return and redemption mechanics.
